main_body: deciduous tree with spherical foliage clumps and trunk
top_band: light green top-lit foliage crown across rows 1-18 and upper halves of each foliage clump
evidence: The tree canopy is composed of rounded foliage clumps shaded from above/top-left (rows 1-54) overhanging a cylindrical vertical trunk (rows 48-78). Look closely at the base of the trunk (row 78): it ends in a completely flat horizontal line, which is slightly weak, though the canopy volumes clearly read as 3/4 organic forms.

style.evidence: While the canopy has 6 green steps and leaf-clump texture, the trunk (rows 48-78) is stiff, geometric, and lacks the organic root flare, branch integration, and uneven ground contact seen in both Beodeul reference trees. The canopy is also made of repetitive geometric spheres with heavy dark outlines separating every ball, whereas the references have irregular, airy leaf clusters with branches peeking through.
